name: CBR250R MC41, Keihin software KYJA203 (38770-KYJ-922 / -971)
notes: Built 2026-10-27 from the stock 922 and 971 images and the HondaDLC logs. Confidence: 'confirmed' = checked against the bike, 'likely' = strong evidence, 'guess' = shape only. Never add a table without evidence.

rpm.evidence: 29 increasing words; x 18000/65536 gives round rpm: 800, 1000, 1200, 1300 ... 10000, 10500. 29 = the row count of the four maps.

tps.evidence: 22 increasing words from 0 to 1023 (10-bit ADC), dense at small openings. 22 = the column count. Fuel A / ignition A follow it: logged advance vs ignition A interpolated on rpm x TPS gives r = 0.83.

map.evidence: 22 increasing bytes 0..255 straight after the TPS axis. Assumed to be the MAP sensor (fuel B rises steadily across it).

tables.name: Fuel A (rpm x throttle)
tables.evidence: 29 x 22 words, every row rises with throttle and flattens at wide open. Logged injector time (table 0x11 bytes 14-15) vs this map: r = 0.76 (bike on the stand, faulty).

tables.name: Fuel B (rpm x MAP)
tables.evidence: 29 x 22 words straight after fuel A, rising across the columns. Which axis it uses and when the ECU uses it (low throttle / idle?) is not known.

tables.name: Ignition A (rpm x throttle)
tables.evidence: 29 x 22 bytes, rises with rpm and falls with load like an advance map. Logged advance (table 0x11 byte 16) vs this map: r = 0.83, about 0.9 x map + 94.

tables.name: Ignition B (rpm x MAP)
tables.evidence: 29 x 22 bytes, same shape as ignition A. The only calibration table that differs between the 922 and 971 images (0xAD40-0xADA0: 3F/40 vs 39/3A).

options.name: O2 sensor closed loop off
options.note: Needs the flag or the closed-loop limits found in the code first.

options.name: PAIR (air injection) solenoid off + its fault code
options.note: Check the workshop manual DTC list: if there is no PAIR code, unplugging the solenoid may be enough.

options.name: O2 sensor / heater fault codes off (21-1, 23-1)
options.note: Only if the sensor is removed. Needs the DTC enable table found first.

options.name: Bank angle fault code off (54-2)
options.note: The sensor is missing on this bike; fitting one is the better fix (it also cuts the engine in a crash).
